header.description: Scaled radial functions j^_n, h^_n (complex z), i^_n, k^_n (real x) and their derivatives (CONVENTIONS §3.15, Radial functions and scaling; Helmholtz CH1.2b; spike S3's sets)
header.format: per set: family (j, h, i, k), z = [re, im] and s as decimal strings of doubles; rows [n, value re, value im, derivative re, derivative im] and, for j, the envelopes of the value and of the derivative; 0 where the value is below 1e-300
